DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 夕食の材料をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for dinner ingredients?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友達と二人で作ります。安い材料なら何でもいいと言われましたが、辛い料理もよいかは聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 安い材料への了承と辛さの希望は未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend and I will cook together. They said any inexpensive ingredients were fine, but I haven't asked whether spicy food is okay too.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that inexpensive ingredients were agreed to but spice preferences remain unconfirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予算と味の希望は、別にお確かめください。今日はどのくらい買うご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check budget and taste preferences separately. How much do you plan to buy today?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二人分だけです。まとめ買いの安さより、二人で使い切れる量を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二人分で使い切る量を優先して容量を比べたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only enough for two. Rather than bulk-buy savings, I'd like to see an amount the two of us can finish.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to compare sizes while prioritizing an amount for two to use up.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの商品は容量と表示価格を比較できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can compare these products' quantities and displayed prices.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小さい方も見ます。辛い調味料は今は選ばず、友達に味の希望を連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小容量も見て辛味料選択は友人へ確認後にすると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll look at the smaller one too. I won't choose spicy seasonings now; I'll contact my friend about flavor preferences.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check small sizes too and choose spicy seasonings after asking your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 作る料理も、お二人で決めてから選べますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can choose after deciding the dish together too.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。私が食べたい料理の写真を送りますが、写真を見た返事だけで辛さの了承とは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真への返事だけを辛さの了承にしないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll send a photo of the dish I'd like, but won't take a reply to the photo alone as agreement to spiciness.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that a photo reply alone does not mean agreement to spice.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 返答を待つ間に、すでに決まった材料を確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: While waiting, would you like to check ingredients already decided?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 主食は二人とも米でよいと確認済みです。決まった物と未決定の調味料を分け、予算内か合計を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 米は合意済で未決定調味料と分け合計予算を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: We've confirmed both are fine with rice as the staple. I'll separate agreed items from undecided seasonings and check the total against our budget.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that rice is agreed, distinguish undecided seasonings and check the total budget.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お二人の希望がまとまりましたらお声がけください。それでは、お買い物をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Call us once you've agreed on your preferences. Enjoy your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計は、こちらの二点でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are these two items all for checkout?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。周りの音で金額が聞こえなかったので、合計の表示を見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 騒音で合計が聞こえず表示を見せてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I couldn't hear the amount over the surrounding noise; could you show me the total display?
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to see the display because noise prevented you hearing the total.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの一番下の欄です。袋は必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's the bottom field here. Do you need a bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 袋は要りません。合計は六百八十円ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋不要と合計六百八十円を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No bag, please. The total is six hundred eighty yen, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm no bag and a 680-yen total in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、六百八十円です。お支払いはどうなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, six hundred eighty yen. How will you pay?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 現金で払います。小銭を数えるので、少し待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現金払いを選び小銭を数える時間を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Cash. Please wait a little while I count the coins.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose cash and ask for time to count coins in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どうぞ。こちらの台に置いていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Of course. You can place them on this tray.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 六百八十円、ちょうどあります。この台に置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 六百八十円ちょうどを台へ置くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have exactly six hundred eighty yen. I'll put it on this tray.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will put exactly 680 yen on the tray.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確かにお預かりしました。こちらがレシートです。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Received, thank you. Here is the receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。レシートも受け取りました。表示で確かめられて助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: レシート受領と表示確認への感謝を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I've received the receipt too. It helped to confirm the amount on the display.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm receipt collection and thank staff for the display check in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらこそ、ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you too. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: アンケートについてのお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the questionnaire?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。参加したくないから空欄にしたのではありません。質問の意味が分からない項目がありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 空欄は不参加希望でなく意味不明のためと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I didn't leave it blank because I don't want to participate. There was a question whose meaning I didn't understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the blank is due to unclear meaning, not a wish not to participate.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの項目か、用紙で教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you show me which item on the form?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三番です。活動に参加した回数なのか、今後参加したい回数なのか読み取れませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三番が過去回数か希望回数か分からないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Number three. I couldn't tell whether it meant how many times I participated or how many times I'd like to participate in future.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you cannot tell whether number three asks past or desired future frequency.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 設問の意図は、担当へ確認します。ほかの回答は記入済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the question's intent with staff. Have you completed the other answers?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ほかは書きました。分かった項目まで全部取り消すのでなく、三番だけ説明を聞いて答えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他回答は残し三番だけ説明後に答えたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Rather than cancel all the answers I understood too, I'd like only number three explained before I answer it.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to retain other answers and answer only number three after an explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 空欄の扱いについても、お尋ねいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can also ask how blanks are handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。空欄をゼロ回と集計するのか、未回答とするのかも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 空欄がゼロ回か未回答として集計されるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please. I'd also like to check whether a blank counts as zero times or as unanswered.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the blank is counted as zero or unanswered.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付後の訂正方法は、担当の案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please follow staff guidance about corrections after submission.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだ提出していません。意味と集計方法を聞いてから出します。答えたくない人もいるので、全員の空欄が私と同じ理由だとは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未提出で確認後提出し他人の空欄理由は断定しないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I haven't submitted yet. I'll hear the meaning and counting method first. Some people don't want to answer, so I won't claim everyone leaves blanks for the same reason as me.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not submitted, will check first, and won't assume others' reasons for blanks.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 三番の説明と扱いを担当へ確認します。それでは、用紙をお持ちのままお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll check the explanation and handling of number three with staff. Please keep the form and wait. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 二通のお手紙を差し出されるご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to post two letters?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。同じ友達へ、長い話を二つに分けました。別々に送れば、書いた順に読んでもらえると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 長話を二通に分け発送順で読まれると思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I split a long story into two letters to the same friend. I thought posting them separately meant they would read them in the order written.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you split a long story into two letters and assumed posting order meant reading order.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 届く順序や読む順序は、ご自身の番号だけで保証されるものではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your own numbering alone doesn't guarantee arrival or reading order.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうですね。最初の話が一通目にしかないので、二通目から読むと意味が分かりにくくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 冒頭が一通目のみで逆順だと意味不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's true. The beginning is only in the first, so reading the second first would make it hard to understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the beginning is only in the first letter and reverse reading would be confusing.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一つの郵便物へまとめるご希望も、送り方としてご相談いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You may also ask about combining them into one postal item.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まとめられるか聞きたいです。中の紙には一、二と番号を付け、二通目だけでも続きだと分かるよう書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: まとめ発送可否を尋ね紙に番号と続き説明を付けると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to ask whether they can be combined. I'll number the papers one and two and write that the second is a continuation so it's clear on its own too.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about combined posting and say in Japanese that you will number pages and explain the continuation.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まとめる場合は、完成した状態で大きさや重さを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: If combining, we'll check size and weight in the completed condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。封筒を二つ重ねるだけで一通の料金になるとは決めず、包み方を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 重ね封筒が自動で一料金とせず外装方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please. I won't assume stacking two envelopes means one postage charge; I'll ask how to package them.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about outer packaging without assuming stacked envelopes automatically mean one charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お送りになる内容は、これで全部でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is this everything you intend to send?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: これで全部です。番号と説明を見直してから準備します。郵便の順序に物語の説明を任せないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 全内容を示し番号説明を直して郵送順へ物語説明を委ねないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, all of it. I'll review numbers and explanations before preparing it. I won't leave explaining the story to the order of postal delivery.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show all contents and say in Japanese that you will review numbering and explanations rather than rely on postal order to explain the story.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: まとめ方をご案内します。それでは、二通ともお手元に残したまま確認をお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll explain how to combine them. Keep both letters with you while waiting for confirmation. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの硬貨についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about this coin, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 祖母からもらった物です。祖母が大切にしていたので、高い金額の硬貨だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 祖母が大切にした物を高額硬貨と思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My grandmother gave it to me. She treasured it, so I thought it was worth a large amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you thought an item treasured by your grandmother was a high-value coin.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 思い出としての価値と、金額の取扱いは別に確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Its value as a memory and its monetary handling need checking separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。祖母が高く買ったと言ったわけではありません。私が気持ちを金額へ置き換えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 祖母の購入額証言はなく気持ちを金額化したと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. She didn't say she bought it for a high price. I converted her feelings into an assumed amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your grandmother did not state a purchase price and you turned emotional value into monetary value.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どのような取扱いをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: How would you like it handled?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は使ったり売ったりしたいのではなく、どこで種類を確認できるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 売買や支出ではなく種類の確認先を知りたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Today I don't want to spend or sell it; I'd like to know where I can check what type it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want a contact for identification, not sale, purchase or spending.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できる範囲と相談先を担当へお尋ねいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can ask staff about the scope they can check and the right contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。見た目が硬貨でも、通貨なのか記念品なのか分からないまま入金用とは説明しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通貨か記念品か不明で入金目的とは申告しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please. Even if it looks like a coin, I won't describe it as for deposit without knowing whether it's currency or a commemorative item.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that currency versus souvenir status is unknown and you won't claim a deposit purpose.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入れ物や、受け取った時の資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you have its case or materials from when you received it?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この箱も持っています。箱の文字と硬貨そのものを一緒に見てもらい、祖母の思い出は自分で大切に残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箱資料と本体を提示し思い出の価値を別に保つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have this box too. I'd like the box text and item checked together, while keeping my grandmother's memories dear separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Present the box information and item and say in Japanese that you will separately preserve its sentimental value.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 種類の確認について担当へご相談ください。それでは、硬貨と箱をそのままお持ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please consult staff about identifying the type. Keep the coin and box as they are. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 模型で気になった所がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything about the model that caught your attention?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 見える窓から部屋を想像しました。裏側にも同じ部屋がある、と子どもへ話しましたが、説明を読んだわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 模型の裏側も同室と子に伝えたが資料根拠はないと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I imagined rooms from the visible windows. I told my child the same rooms were at the back too, but hadn't read any explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you told your child the back had the same rooms without documentary support.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 模型で見える部分と、資料で分かる部分を分けて見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's distinguish what the model shows from what documents establish.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。ここからは片側だけ見えます。左右が同じ作りだという説明は、自分で付け足しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 片側だけ見え左右対称は自分の付加と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Only one side is visible here. I added the idea that both sides have the same layout myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that only one side is visible and symmetry was your own addition.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認したい点を、展示の解説担当へお尋ねいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can ask the exhibit interpreter about points you want to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。子どもには、裏側の話は私の想像だったと伝え直します。模型で見た事実にしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子へ裏側は想像と訂正し観察事実としないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please. I'll tell my child again that the back was my imagination. I won't present it as a fact seen in the model.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will correct the back-side explanation to your child as imagination, not observation.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 想像して楽しむことと、実際の構造を説明することは別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Enjoying imagination and explaining the actual structure are different.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そうですね。もし資料がなければ、分からないままにして、必ず同じ部屋があるとは言わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 資料がなければ不明を残し同室と断定しないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: That's true. If there are no materials, I'll leave it unknown rather than say the same rooms definitely exist.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that without sources you will leave it uncertain and not assert identical rooms.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まず、この模型が何を表しているか、解説を確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: First, let's check the explanation of what this model represents.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 題名と説明を見ます。昔の全ての部屋をそのまま再現した模型かどうかも、先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 模型題名と説明で全室再現なのか先に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll look at the title and explanation. I'd also like to ask first whether it reproduces all the historical rooms exactly.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to check the title and explanation and whether all rooms are reproduced.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認したい点を伺いました。それでは、解説と合わせてご見学ください。どうぞお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've heard your questions. Please view it together with the explanation. Enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 実演の説明で、ご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have questions about the demonstration explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 鳥が魚を持っている場面を見ました。鳥が自分で夕食を集める物語だと、友達へ説明しかけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鳥の魚保持を夕食集めの物語と説明しかけたと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: I saw a bird holding a fish. I almost told my friend a story that the bird was gathering its own dinner.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you nearly explained the bird holding fish as a dinner-gathering story.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その場面の意味は、解説と合わせてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the scene's meaning together with the commentary.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。楽しい物語を自分で作っただけでした。見た動きと、私が考えた理由を分けて話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 観察動作と自己の理由づけを分けると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I had simply made up an enjoyable story. I'll separate the movements I saw from the reasons I imagined.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will separate observed actions from your own explanations of their reasons.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 具体的にどの場面か、お知らせいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: Could you tell us specifically which scene?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 鳥が魚を持った後、人が近くへ来た所です。その前の説明は、遅れて来たので聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 人が近づく場面を示し開始前説明は未聴取と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: Where a person came close after the bird held the fish. I arrived late and didn't hear the earlier explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify the approaching-person scene and say in Japanese that you missed the opening explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 聞けなかった部分も含めて、解説担当へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ask the interpreter including about the part you missed.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。友達の質問へ全部分かったふりで答えず、見たのはその場面だけだと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 質問へ理解済と装わず見た場面の範囲を話すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please. Rather than answer my friend's questions pretending I understood everything, I'll say I saw only that scene.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not pretend full understanding and will explain the scope of what you saw.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認した説明を、改めて共有できますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can share the confirmed explanation afterwards.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。鳥の気持ちまで分かったと言わず、展示で説明された役割と私の感想を別にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 解説の役割と感想を分け鳥の気持ちを断定しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. I won't say I understand even the bird's feelings; I'll separate the role explained in the exhibit from my impressions.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will distinguish the explained role from your impressions and not assert the bird's feelings.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご質問を担当へ伝えます。それでは、解説をご確認ください。ご見学をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass your question to staff. Please check the commentary. Enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お子様と少しお休みになる場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for somewhere to rest briefly with your child?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ゲームに負けて泣いています。落ち着くまで遊んだ場所を空けたままにしておきたいと言っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 敗戦で泣く子が休憩中も場所確保を望むと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child is crying after losing a game. They say they want the place where they played kept empty until they calm down.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about a child crying after losing and wanting to reserve the play space during a break.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 気持ちを落ち着けることと、共有の場所を取っておくことは分けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's separate calming down from keeping a shared place reserved.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。他の子が遊べるよう、道具を持って端へ移ります。泣いているから場所を使えないようにするのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 共有場所を空け道具と親子で端へ移ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. We'll take the equipment and move to the side so other children can play. I won't make the space unavailable just because my child is crying.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you and your child will move aside with the equipment and free the shared space.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご一緒の方にも、移動することをお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tell your companions too that you are moving.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友達の親へ、終わりではなく少し休むと話します。でも、戻る時刻を決めて皆を待たせるつもりではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行者へ休憩と伝えるが再開時刻で皆を待たせないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll tell my friend's parent we're taking a short rest, not finishing. But I don't intend to set a return time and make everyone wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will tell companions it is a break but not make everyone wait for a restart time.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 静かに休める場所の案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the guidance for a quiet resting place.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。子どもには、勝つまで同じ場所を独占するのではなく、気持ちが落ち着いたら次を相談しようと話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 落着き後に次を相談し勝つまで独占しないと子へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please. I'll tell my child that instead of monopolizing the same place until winning, we can discuss what to do next once they calm down.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell your child in Japanese that you will discuss the next step after calming down, without reserving the place until a win.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 再開する場合も、周囲の利用状況を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you resume, check how others are using the place too.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。戻ればすぐ同じ場所が使えるとは約束しません。子どもの話を聞いてから、遊びを続けるか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 再利用を約束せず子の話を聞いて続行を決めると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I won't promise the same place will be immediately available on return. I'll listen to my child before deciding whether to keep playing.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you won't promise reuse and will listen to your child before deciding to continue.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お子様とごゆっくりお休みください。それでは、ほかの方も使えるようご協力をお願いします。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: Rest at your own pace with your child. Thank you for helping others use the place too. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 練習中の出来事について、ご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about something that happened during practice?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 公園で友達と劇の台詞を練習しました。強い言葉を大声で言ったので、通りかかった人が本当の口論だと思ったようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 公園の劇練習で強い大声台詞を口論と心配されたと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: I practiced play lines with a friend in a park. I said harsh words loudly, and someone passing seemed to think it was a real argument.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that loud, harsh play lines in the park made a passerby worry it was an argument.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 実際に相手の方から、何と言われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: What exactly did that person say to you?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「けんかですか」と聞かれました。その人が警察へ連絡したかまでは知りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: けんかかと問われた事実と警察通報不明を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: They asked, “Are you fighting?” I don't know whether they contacted the police.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Separate the actual question about fighting from unknown police contact in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身の行動と、確認できた相手の反応を分けて教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tell me your own actions separately from the other person's confirmed response.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私は台本を読みましたが、見ていない人には説明がありませんでした。相手が誤解したせいだけにしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 台本読上げは自分だけ分かり周囲のせいだけにしないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: I read the script, but people who hadn't seen it had no explanation. I won't blame it only on their misunderstanding.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that only you knew you were reading a script and you won't blame others alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 場所の利用については管理担当にもご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also consult management about use of the place.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。劇の練習だからどこで叫んでもよいとは考えず、声を出せる場所や方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 劇という理由で自由に叫べるとせず管理者へ方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't assume play rehearsal means I may shout anywhere; I'll check suitable places and methods for speaking loudly.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that a play does not permit shouting anywhere and you will ask management about methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 同じことを繰り返す前に、周囲への影響もお考えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: Consider the effect on those around you before repeating it.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 次は友達と練習方法を変えます。練習だという札だけで全て解決するとは決めず、まず台詞を大声で言うことをやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 札だけで解決とせず大声練習を止め仲間と方法を変えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: Next time I'll change the practice method with my friend. I won't assume a “rehearsal” sign solves everything; first I'll stop saying the lines loudly.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not rely on a sign alone, will stop loud practice and change methods with your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 状況を伺いました。それでは、場所と練習方法を確認してご準備ください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've heard the situation. Please check the place and practice method before preparing. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お薬についてお尋ねします。お答えしにくい点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll ask about your medicine. Is anything difficult to answer?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 質問にすぐ答えないといけないと思い、知っている言葉だけで返事をしていました。少し考える時間がほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 即答必須と思い既知語だけ返事したので考える時間を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I had to reply immediately and was answering with only words I knew. I'd like a little time to think.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you used only familiar words believing immediate replies were required, and ask for thinking time.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 分かることを、ご自身のペースでお話しください。黙っている時は、考えているということでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tell us what you know at your own pace. When silent, may we understand that you are thinking?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。黙っているのは了承の意味ではありません。薬の名前を思い出す間、少し待っていただけると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 沈黙は了承でなく名称を思い出していると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Silence doesn't mean agreement. It would help if you waited while I recall the medicine's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that silence means recalling the name, not agreement.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋など、確認できる情報も使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can also use information we can check, such as the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持っています。覚えているか試されていると思いましたが、袋を見て正確に話してよいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋を示し記憶試験でなく資料で正確に答えてよいか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have it. I thought my memory was being tested, but it's okay to look at the bag and answer accurately, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the bag and confirm in Japanese that it is not a memory test and you may use documents to answer accurately.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。思い出せない場合も、その点を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. If you can't remember, say that too.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。知らない名前へ「はい」と答えるのでなく、読めない所を指して質問します。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不明名へ同意せず読めない部分を示して質問すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. Rather than answer yes to an unfamiliar name, I'll point at what I can't read and ask.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not agree to an unknown name and will point at unreadable text to ask.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 説明の後も、理解できた点を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: After an explanation, you can check what you understood too.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。まず最後まで聞き、分かった内容を自分の言葉で確かめます。考えている時は、そのことも言います。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明後自己表現で理解確認し思考中もその旨伝えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please. I'll first listen to the end, then confirm what I understood in my own words. I'll also say when I'm thinking.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that after explanations you will check understanding in your own words and indicate when thinking.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お話しのペースを伺いました。それでは、袋を見ながら一つずつ確認しましょう。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've heard your preferred pace. Let's check one thing at a time while looking at the bag. Excuse me.
